title: The conversation list
purpose: The kit's list of past conversations (ConversationHistory of pi-chat, which wraps ConversationList): a card on a wide screen, a bottom drawer on a phone, with New, search, the Archived filter and row actions (rename, archive, delete), fed by the `conversations` config of invented items on a neutral page. The History button around it is the consumer's own.

fixture.usage: <ConversationHistory conversations={{ items, activeId, onSelect, onNew, search, rename, archive, remove }} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} />

notes: A row is at least 48 px on a phone; the open conversation is marked; a search that finds nothing says so in words; New and close are always in reach at the top; long titles are cut on one line, never the time.

steps.expect: The search field has my word.
Only the conversations about an invoice are listed.
The list shows the archived conversations, or says there is none.
The list closes and the page shows that conversation.
The list closes and an empty conversation is open.

flows.name: Open the list and close it with Escape

steps.expect: The list opens over the page with the open conversation marked.
The list closes and focus is back on the button that opened it.
